name: Okota Mikan
source:
Okota Mikan is a Nekomimi being which is a sub-species falling under the diverse Genus Familia known as Kemonomimi's.
Although Mikan is is technically a Kemonomimi, her personality traits more accurately align with that of a beastkin or "beastman".

She has little regard for the social customs of human society, primarily focusing on satisfying her immediate needs in spite of anything and everything else that may be happening around her. When aroused she enters a near feral state & her wildcards mental state becomes dominant in her immediate personality.

She is a VERY whiny Nekomimi,, preferring to be spoiled endlessly; and she will throw temper tantrums when she doesn't get her immediate way.... going as far as to begin crying, whailing, and screaming.

It is very apparent throughout the course of the story that Okota Mikan is an animal-human hybrid of lower intelligence,  which also lends merit to her personality being closer to that of a beastkin & not at all unlike her Wolf/Human cousins: the Ookamimi.
